header.name: Ethics in AI
header.description: Artificial Intelligence is slowly becoming a significant part of our lives. It is in the process of continuous evolution and change and holds the possibility of changing lives and affecting us in myriad ways. Its continuous evolution and embeddness in life poses significant ethical question. The question of ethics arises not only at the level of the interaction of the AI systems with society and human beings but at the level of design of such systems. This course studies the ethics of AI. The course is divided into two parts. In the first part we will study the questions of fairness, transparency, justice linked to AI and the ethics of its deployment in various settings of healthcare, warfare, autonomous vehicles, education etc. The second part will specifically look at the question of ethical design of AI systems. In this regard it will seek to integrate ethics into the design of AI systems through practical demonstrations and applications.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Demonstrate an understanding of philosophical problems in the ethics of AI

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Enable the student to identify ethical issues in the existing AI models

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Demonstrate clarity, precision, and accuracy in reasoning and able to understand ethical dilemmas and avoid fallacies

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Demonstrate knowledge of the practical (cultural), social, and policy implications of AI

outcomes.label: CO5
outcomes.raw_text: Learn to Embed ethics in the design of AI systems
